explanation: The vulnerable generate_jwt signs JWTs with WEBUI_SK, a hard-coded module-level signing key (documented by the advisory as residing in astrbot/core/__init__.py), enabling remote authentication bypass and subsequent RCE via malicious plugin installation. The fix removes the hard-coded key, sourcing the secret from configuration and failing closed when unset, which materially corrects the defect. This matches CWE-321 (Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key) and rule CRYPTO-007.
finding: JWT tokens signed with hard-coded cryptographic key WEBUI_SK, allowing authentication bypass and remote code execution.
note: The literal hard-coded key value in astrbot/core/__init__.py is not shown in the code pair; the hard-coded nature of WEBUI_SK is corroborated by the advisory text and the fix requiring a configured secret. No license information in supplied evidence.
